distress.title: You don't have to do this alone
distress.body: It sounds like things are hard right now. If you are in danger or thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, US) or call 911. You can pause sign-up at any time, and nothing you've entered is lost.
actions: Ask for a person to call me

upload_failed.title: That photo didn't work, and that's okay
upload_failed.body: Photos of IDs can be tricky. You can try again in brighter light with the card flat, or skip the photo and type your details instead. Both ways finish sign-up.

ocr_low_confidence.title: Please double-check a few details
ocr_low_confidence.body: We filled in what we could read from your photo. Fields marked for review may be wrong. Please check them and fix anything that isn't right before you continue.

booking_conflict.title: Someone just took that time
booking_conflict.body: That appointment was booked a moment ago. Here are the next open times. Your other answers are saved.

long_pause.title: Take your time
long_pause.body: There's no rush. Your progress is saved as you go. If a question is unclear, you can skip it and a member of our team will help when you visit.
